name: Swara Baby Products
summary: Swara Baby Products, promoted by FirstCry parent Brainbees Solutions, is the largest contract manufacturer of disposable hygiene products such as baby and adult diapers in India, with four plants in Madhya Pradesh. Revenue grew from ₹767 cr in FY24 to ₹1,212 cr in FY26 and profit rose 18.5% in FY26 to ₹95.6 cr, but the net margin fell from about 12% to about 8% and borrowings grew faster than revenue to ₹443 cr. At ₹111 the post-issue market cap is ₹3,211.56 cr, about 33.6 times FY26 profit and 3.05 times post-issue book value, and the RHP names no listed peers to compare against. The top 10 customers give 80.3% of revenue and sales to related parties (mainly Brainbees) are about 25.7% of revenue, shares were allotted and transferred at an adjusted ₹22.50 within the last year, and cases are pending against the promoters and a director.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹766.6 cr (FY24) to ₹1,212.4 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 25.8%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹766.6 cr, ₹959.7 cr, ₹1,212.4 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.81 at 31 March 2026.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 70% (₹260.1 cr to ₹443.1 cr) while revenue rose 58% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹319.4 cr, ₹399.9 cr, ₹553.2 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: FY26 operating cash flow was ₹74.87 cr, about 78% of PAT of ₹95.59 cr.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax rose about 18.5% in FY26, to ₹95.6 cr from ₹80.7 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin fell from about 12.3% in FY24 (PAT ₹94.0 cr on ₹766.6 cr) to 8.2% in FY26.

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 17.28% in FY26 (ROE 20.06%).

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 16.19% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: The RHP says there are no listed peers of comparable size, scale and business model.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: No listed peers are named in the RHP, so P/E cannot be compared; post-issue P/E at ₹111 is about 33.6x FY26 PAT.

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: No listed peers are named in the RHP, so P/B cannot be compared; post-issue P/B at ₹111 is about 3.05x.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: No listed peers are named in the RHP, so market cap to sales cannot be compared; it is about 2.76x FY26 revenue from operations.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: Shares were allotted in December 2025 and transferred in March 2026 at an adjusted ₹22.50, about 80% below the ₹111 upper band.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoter and promoter group holding falls from 100% to 75.09% after the issue.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: The RHP states promoter shares are not pledged or encumbered, apart from a 1.62% non-disposal undertaking.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: FY26 sales to related parties were ₹299.5 cr, about 25.7% of revenue from operations, with Brainbees alone at 22.64%.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: Pending against promoters: 2 criminal, 3 regulatory and 16 tax cases (₹16.68 cr), plus criminal cases against director Supam Maheshwari.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The offer for sale is ₹300 cr of the ₹799.88 cr issue, about 37.5%.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The ₹799.88 cr issue is about 24.9% of the ₹3,211.56 cr post-issue market cap at ₹111.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: Selling shareholders sell equal amounts at costs of ₹24.55 (Brainbees) and ₹2.13 (Anadya), an average of ₹13.34, so ₹111 is about 8.3x their cost.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹198.21 cr of the ₹499.88 cr fresh issue (about 39.7%, just under the line) is for capex on a new project.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: ₹127.5 cr (about 25.5%) of the fresh issue repays borrowings of the company and its subsidiaries.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: The general corporate purposes amount is not fixed; the RHP caps it at 25% of the fresh issue.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: All loans to be repaid are from HDFC Bank, and the RHP says the Brainbees loan will not be repaid from the proceeds.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Cases against the company and subsidiaries total about ₹3.39 cr, about 0.6% of ₹553.22 cr net worth.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: No criminal or regulatory cases against the company, but promoter Brainbees faces customs (₹6.57 cr) and other cases and a director faces criminal cases.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹0.14 cr at 30 June 2026, 0.03% of net worth.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top 10 customers gave 80.31% of FY26 revenue from operations, with Brainbees at 22.64%.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: The top 10 suppliers were 69.43% of FY26 purchases; the largest single supplier share was not found.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: The company was incorporated in November 2016, about 10 years ago.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: The statutory auditor, Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, gave unmodified opinions on the restated financials.
